phase_1.title: Phase 1 · HK UMP45 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the .45 ACP (11.43×23mm) primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 145 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 145 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 200 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Blowback Cycle & Operating Impulse

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 25-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the HK UMP45 staged for its 600 RPM (Semi / 2-Round Burst / Full-Auto) cadence.

zh.headline: HK UMP45 .45 ACP 通用冲锋枪：1999 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: HK UMP45 作为 MP5 的轻量化低成本继任方案推出，摒弃复杂滚柱延迟改用重型闭膛自由枪机与高强度聚合物上下机匣；天生契合亚音速 .45 ACP 重弹，600 发/分沉稳节奏配合空仓挂机显著提升近距停止作用。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：HK UMP45 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1999 年问世的 HK UMP45 .45 ACP 通用冲锋枪 由德国黑克勒-科赫（Heckler & Koch）主导研制，定位为经典的聚合物闭膛冲锋枪。1999 年投产的 UMP45 专门瞄准偏爱 .45 ACP 大口径停止作用的北美执法与特警市场，成为多国特勤与边防部队制式近战冲锋枪。
HK UMP45 作为 MP5 的轻量化低成本继任方案推出，摒弃复杂滚柱延迟改用重型闭膛自由枪机与高强度聚合物上下机匣；天生契合亚音速 .45 ACP 重弹，600 发/分沉稳节奏配合空仓挂机显著提升近距停止作用。 整件装备总长 690 mm（侧折叠托 450 mm）、空重 2.3 kg，成为同期冲锋枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1999 年，德国黑克勒-科赫（Heckler & Koch）推出了划时代的HK UMP45 .45 ACP 通用冲锋枪。1999 年投产的 UMP45 专门瞄准偏爱 .45 ACP 大口径停止作用的北美执法与特警市场，成为多国特勤与边防部队制式近战冲锋枪。 它的核心设计聚焦于全聚合物上下机匣将空枪质量压至 2.3 kg，零件数与造价远低于滚柱延迟 MP5，奠定了其在冲锋枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: HK UMP45 .45 ACP 通用冲锋枪 的机械灵魂在于其「闭膛待击自由枪机 · 聚合物机匣 + 射速缓冲配重」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，闭膛击发后弹壳底缘克服枪机质量与复进簧阻力直线后坐完成抽抛，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物精加工而成。闭膛待击保证首发射击精度，配备 HK 经典空仓挂机与拍击释放槽，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。HK UMP45 .45 ACP 通用冲锋枪 采用闭膛待击自由枪机 · 聚合物机匣 + 射速缓冲配重。在每个击发周期中，闭膛击发后弹壳底缘克服枪机质量与复进簧阻力直线后坐完成抽抛。借助硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了闭膛待击保证首发射击精度，配备 HK 经典空仓挂机与拍击释放槽。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 .45 ACP (11.43×23mm) 弹药规格与 200 mm 冷锻多边形膛线（6 棱右旋 1:406 mm），最高工作膛压约 145 MPa，可赋予弹头 285 m/s 的出膛初速与 605 J 动能，有效作用距离达 100 米。
内膛技术特点方面，HK 标志性 6 棱冷锻多边形膛线改善气密性并延长重弹头枪管寿命。同时，亚音速 .45 ACP 重弹天然适配快拆消音器，无需特制减装药弹即可降噪，令其在 600 发/分（单发 / 两发点射 / 全自动） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 200 毫米身管与 .45 ACP (11.43×23mm) 口径，HK UMP45 .45 ACP 通用冲锋枪 实现了每秒 285 米的初速与 100 米有效射程。HK 标志性 6 棱冷锻多边形膛线改善气密性并延长重弹头枪管寿命，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 25 发容量的25 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 48 mm 膛轴设计，HK UMP45 .45 ACP 通用冲锋枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 5.7 N·s 水平。模块化弹匣与枪管组件可在 .45 ACP / .40 S&W / 9×19mm 三口径间快速互换。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-61）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 25 发容量的25 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，模块化弹匣与枪管组件可在 .45 ACP / .40 S&W / 9×19mm 三口径间快速互换。欢迎在 BAY-61 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 HK UMP45 .45 ACP 通用冲锋枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the HK UMP45
paragraphs: Introduced in 1999 by Heckler & Koch in Germany, the Heckler & Koch UMP45 emerged as a defining Polymer Closed-Bolt Submachine Gun. Introduced in 1999 to satisfy U.S. law-enforcement demand for .45 ACP stopping power in a modern platform, the UMP45 became a staple of SWAT and border-patrol units.

Developed as a lightweight, cost-efficient sibling to the MP5, the HK UMP45 pairs a fiber-reinforced polymer receiver with a closed-bolt blowback action tuned specifically around subsonic .45 ACP ammunition at a steady 600 RPM. Measuring 690 mm (450 mm Stock Folded) at an unloaded weight of 2.3 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Submachine Gun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1999, Heckler & Koch of Germany introduced the Heckler & Koch UMP45. Introduced in 1999 to satisfy U.S. law-enforcement demand for .45 ACP stopping power in a modern platform, the UMP45 became a staple of SWAT and border-patrol units. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Reinforced polymer upper and lower drop empty mass to 2.3 kg while simplifying maintenance — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Heckler & Koch UMP45 sits its Closed-Bolt Straight Blowback · Reinforced Polymer Receiver with Cyclic Rate Reducer. Throughout every firing cycle, closed-bolt firing relies on breechblock inertia and recoil spring tension to cycle reliably, containing 145 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Closed-bolt firing ensures crisp first-round accuracy alongside a last-round bolt hold-open, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Heckler & Koch UMP45 relies on Closed-Bolt Straight Blowback · Reinforced Polymer Receiver with Cyclic Rate Reducer. During each cycle, closed-bolt firing relies on breechblock inertia and recoil spring tension to cycle reliably. Machined from hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Closed-bolt firing ensures crisp first-round accuracy alongside a last-round bolt hold-open.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for .45 ACP (11.43×23mm) with 200 mm Cold-Hammer-Forged Polygonal (6-Land RH, 1:406 mm), the Heckler & Koch UMP45 develops 285 m/s muzzle velocity and 605 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 100 meters.

Internally, Signature HK cold-hammer-forged polygonal rifling improves gas seal and extends barrel service life. Combined with its 600 RPM (Semi / 2-Round Burst / Full-Auto) tempo, Naturally subsonic .45 ACP ballistics pair cleanly with quick-detach suppressors, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving .45 ACP (11.43×23mm) through its 200 millimeter bore, the Heckler & Koch UMP45 achieves 285 meters per second and 100 meters of effective reach. Signature HK cold-hammer-forged polygonal rifling improves gas seal and extends barrel service life.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 25-round 25-round detachable magazine body with a 48 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 5.7 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Modular barrel, bolt, and magazine architecture converts rapidly between .45 ACP, .40, and 9mm.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-61), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
